text:
Alex: Midweek async — quick checkin for gateway/routing/auth/rate limits. What I did: rolled canary for new routing policy v2 to us-west (35% -> 60% in 45m). Saw a small uptick in 429s from long-tail clients. Blocker: unsure if JWT rotation window in prod is causing auth retries. Today: watching metrics, prepping a small patch to token bucket config if needed.

Maria: Thanks. Do you have the exact 429 distribution? region/service?

Alex: Mostly us-west, 70% from /v1/generate endpoints, concentrated on clients with long streaming sessions. P95 latency unchanged. 429 spikes align with bursts — suspect bucket config + large concurrency.

Sam: If it's burst related, we can try lowering `burst_size` or increase `refill_rate` for the gateway policy. Quick experiment idea: bump refill by 20% for canary only.

Jing: I can open a tiny PR to adjust defaults and scope it to the routing-policy canary. Will also add a metric emit for `kbucket_drain_rate`. Pinged in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8212 :eyes:

OpsBot: Note: JWT rotation job ran at 03:15 UTC today. Rotations completed successfully for 99.97% tokens, 0.03% transient failures retried.

Alex: Nice — that suggests rotation likely not primary cause but might amplify client retries.

DeployBot: Canary update: traffic to v2 at 60%. Error rate (5m avg) increased from 0.22% -> 0.73%. 429 rate increased from 0.05% -> 0.55% in last 30m.

Maria: Ok if PR is ready, let's do canary-scoped config change first rather than full rollback. If 429 >1% sustained for 5m, we rollback.

Jing: Created PR, added feature-flagged change and a small health-check script. Example quick test command in PR: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <test>" https://gw-us-west.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` — run against canary lb.

Sam: I'll run a quick load test against the canary after Jing's change merges. Using the same session pattern as the failing clients (long polling + keepalive).

Alex: Blocker for me: need an approval on the PR and confirmation from infra that we can run the load test on canary without impacting prod SLAs.

Maria: I approved the PR, infra gave quick 👍 on test window (15m from now). Sam — over to you.

Sam: Running load test now (15m window). Will post results here.

OpsBot: Reminder: rate-limit config rollout check at 10:30 PDT.

Sam: Load test finished — preliminary: 429s dropped to baseline after PR changes, p95 stable. Details: 5m window error rate fell from 0.7% -> 0.12%.

Alex: Great. I'll keep the canary open and push to full rollout tomorrow morning if no regression overnight. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Jing: I'll follow-up with a small observability dashboard tile to show `kbucket_drain_rate` and `jwt_retry_count` together.

Maria: Moving action items: Jing — PR + dashboard; Sam — finalize load test notes; Alex — monitor overnight and bump to full rollout if green.

Alex: Sounds good. If 429 >1% sustained, I'll trigger rollback and notify infra. Otherwise, proceed tomorrow.

Sam: Leaving test artifacts here: https://internal.redwood/test-results/2487654321-canary-load (logs + grafana snapshots).

Alex: Closing loop — thanks all.
